content.description: Full-structure first proposal: split cars and motorcycles into standard and aggressive/slow archetypes, a space-seeking custom1 subgroup of the moto distribution, box-waiting illegal-left riders, and light swarm/early-start rules for motorcycles only.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Compliant cars: M3/share/car (0.003) and M2/early/car (0.001) are near zero, so no red-running params; tau 1.1 and minGap 2.2 keep M1/car discharge headway near 0.39 s and queue length M5 near 13 m.
Assertive cars with shorter gaps shorten M1/car discharge headway and M6/junction times; lcAssertive raises accepted-gap risk (M8/car 0.056 wrong-lane share) without red running.

Typical riders filter to the front: small minGapLat, high lcSublane and lcMaxSpeedLatStanding raise M4/overshoot_share (0.63) and lower M5/length and M1/moto headway (0.30 s); impatience with jmDriveAfterRedTime lets some run the red to approach M3/share/moto 0.09.
Slow riders in the lane centre raise M6/approach times for moto (s 27 s, l 29 s) toward the observed mean and keep the speed distribution wide.

Space-seeking motorcycles (custom1) can take other lanes or the sidewalk via queue_space_seeking; compact alignment and tight lateral gaps target M4/overshoot_depth (2.0 m) and M8/moto wrong-lane share (0.25).

Illegal-left riders enter the box and wait; low jmTimegapMinor and high impatience make them commit into gaps and exit soon after the opposing green ends, targeting M7a/release_time (2.6 s) and M7b/clear_lag (6.7 s).

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/per_cycle (4.4) and M3/share/moto (0.092) and M3/var_to_mean (1.3): small base probability plus a follower term gives clustered, over-dispersed red running; cars are excluded since their share is 0.003.
Targets M2/early/moto (0.13) by letting front-row motorcycles creep in the last 7 s of red; low v_max keeps first-crossing delay M2/first_delay near 2 s; cars excluded (M2/early/car 0.001).

Seekers trigger at a 10 m queue (observed choice queues 13 m: M9c, M10b); p_right_lane 0.1 and p_sidewalk 0.1 over the 25% seeker share give about 0.025 per moto, matching M9a/M10a rates; p_wrong_lane 0.5 targets M8/moto 0.25 (may be redistributed on the proxy net).
A 1 s extra hold after native release lengthens M7b/clear_lag toward 6.7 s while keeping M7a/release_time near 2.6 s, without touching safety checks.
Slow riders hold the lane centre, which blocks overtaking in-lane and raises M6/approach times for motorcycles toward the observed 27 to 29 s.

reasoning: Built distinct car/moto archetypes, a custom1 seeker subgroup for queue_space_seeking, box-waiting violators, and light motorcycle-only swarm and early-start rules, scaling each probability to the observed M2/M3/M8/M9/M10 rates; all values within the stated bounds and shares sum to 1 per distribution.
